Older homes that grew floor by floor

Old Gurgaon has some of the city's oldest neighbourhoods: dense lanes, independent houses that have grown a floor at a time, and buildings with shops below and homes above. Towards the MG Road side the mix shifts, with apartment complexes alongside older colonies.

In the older houses, tanks have usually been added as the family and the building grew. You might find two or three rooftop tanks of different ages on one roof, a sump tucked under the front steps or a courtyard, and a roof reached only by a narrow staircase. In apartments, water is stored in shared sumps and overhead tanks that the society or building management looks after.

Why tanks here get dirty

Supply water carries fine silt that settles as sludge, and older sumps that have not been cleaned in years can hold a thick layer of it. Rooftop tanks in full summer sun grow algae. In dense areas, dust from busy roads and lanes settles on roofs and finds its way under loose lids. Where a home tops up from a tanker or borewell, sediment tends to build up faster.

What to tell us when you book

  • How many tanks, and roughly what size each one is
  • Which floor the roof is on, and whether there is a lift or only stairs
  • Where the sump manhole is, and whether anything sits on top of it
  • Anything about the lane, such as a narrow entrance or busy market hours
  • For apartments, the number of tanks and who manages them

Our pumps and hoses are portable, and a clear picture of the access helps us bring enough hose and plan the visit.

What we clean and how it works

We clean rooftop plastic tanks and underground concrete sumps, and for apartment buildings with 5 or more tanks we offer bulk rates and tower-by-tower scheduling; see society tank cleaning. Nobody goes inside a tank. A sludge pump, high-pressure jet wash, food-safe disinfectant, clean-water flush and drying take about 60 to 90 minutes per tank, and you get before and after photos on WhatsApp.

Send your details from the quote form or a WhatsApp photo, get a free fixed quote including GST before the visit, pick a slot and pay after the job by UPI or cash.

Nearby areas: we also clean tanks in DLF Phase 1 to 5 and Palam Vihar.

Questions

Our lane is very narrow. Can you still come?

Yes. Our pumps and hoses are portable and can be carried in. Describe the lane in your booking notes so we can plan.

We have a shop downstairs and our home above. Can you clean both buildings' tanks?

Yes, as long as they are rooftop plastic tanks or underground concrete sumps. List every tank in your request for one fixed quote.

Our sump is under the front steps and hasn't been cleaned in years. Is that a problem?

No. We clean it from the manhole with a sludge pump and jet lance, so nobody goes down. Older sumps often hold more sludge, which is exactly why they need it.
